# Keep UI button-control flags separate from collected preferences

The 1959080 patch removes seven disable_button entries from the telemetry collector and schema, while the UI controls remain. A fixed Reload PAC consumer still computes disabled state through its preference object; directory and certificate-manager buttons still bind their named preferences. The accepted Bug rationale applies to these UI implementation controls, not every preference with a similar name. Removing collection does not remove UI or policy behavior. This study read three representative consumers and did not run a policy-lock or telemetry test.

Scope: Preference telemetry boundaries.
